output.reason: [ev-0b6150153730] says Argo CD now uses the `federated_claims.user_id` claim as the RBAC subject instead of the Dex `sub` claim. It also says that if you were using the Dex `sub` claim in RBAC policies, "you will need to update them to maintain the same access". So if the operator does nothing, those policies stop matching and users lose the access the policies gave them. That makes permission-lost (action) the right kind, and the proposed statement and remediation (decode the `sub` claims to find the `user_id`, then use the new CLI) match the evidence.
